issues.title: 'Wild card' is on Filter although it 's not in any properties of item
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
'Wild card' is on Filter although it 's not in any properties of item

**Update from Ian:** the wild-card filter searches through the `label` field.  We should change it so that it does a wildcard search through the `label` *and* `id` fields - since in use there can be some very similar labels, so id is the quickest route to finding an element.

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Add filter 'Wild Cart'
4. Notice it can return some items
5. Click on item at step4
6. Notice no item has properties 'Wild Card', seem it gets from label

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
`Wild card' is not on Filter because of it 's not in any properties of item. 

## 🖥️ Screenshots
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/8df70888-2466-42fe-b070-dd760cc5cc18)


## 💻 System information
 - Browser : Chrome
 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111


## 📝 Additional context

Hmm, I'm ok with `id` and `label`.  The other text fields tend to be drop-downs, so it's easier to search using the specific filter for that field.

Aah, but maybe there's a ux improvement.  Can we name it a bit better?  Any thoughts @Tristina1788 

It's a wildcard search, and it covers the `id` and `label` fields.
